title: cleome simplicifolia
intro: Cleome simplicifolia, commonly known as Yellow Bee Plant or White Bee Plant, is a perennial plant native to the Great Plains region of North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including skin conditions and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of Cleome simplicifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its ability to soothe skin irritations and ease respiratory discomfort. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
